headline: Mutual funds increase stakes in select microcaps for two straight quarters
summary: Mutual funds increased their holdings in 64 Nifty Microcap 250 companies for two consecutive quarters. Ten of these stocks, including Electronics Mart India, Sky Gold, Bluestone Jewellery, Sudarshan Chemical, and Timex Group, surged between 25% and 68% over three months. This trend reflects growing institutional confidence in smaller companies. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap and microcap momentum can observe institutional interest patterns in these names.
why_it_matters: Institutional accumulation validates smaller stocks in your portfolio.
winners_losers: Microcap investors gain / cautious funds neutral
